title: Understanding Mean-Centering
text: Mean-centering involves subtracting the mean of each column from the respective column values, except for the intercept column. This process ensures that the mean of each column is zero.

title: Effect of Mean-Centering on Coefficients
text: When you mean-center the data, the intercept term is not affected, but the other coefficients might change. Consider how this affects the relationship between the coefficients in the original and mean-centered models.

title: Comparing Coefficients
text: The coefficients of the mean-centered model, \(\hat{\gamma}\), are related to the coefficients of the original model, \(\hat{\beta}\), by a transformation that involves the means of the original predictors.

title: Relationship Between \(\hat{\beta}_2\) and \(\hat{\gamma}_2\)
